thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. The pre-open tape is two-sided and the summaries are empty: Dow futures drop on the Iran war and Canada tariffs, while another item says the market's hot streak hints at more good times, so that mix does not justify liquidating the book into cash. Chevron's $7B Venezuela oil bet, Baker Hughes's multi-year OGDC contract, GeoPark's Venezuela question, and ship-fuel shortages name energy names that have no open; I will not invent XOM. Oracle keeps falling, EU regulators warned Oracle ahead of earnings, and one firm says the stock will double, but ORCL has no open. Micron-versus-Sandisk does not say which is the buy, and neither has an open. Nvidia 'sent a strong signal' to AMD and Intel, but the summary does not say which way, so it supports keeping the NVDA line rather than selling IWM to add. IREN, Archer, GitLab, Quanex, Genesco, Nike, Workday, Novartis, and Mistral/Samsung are not in the tape. OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX are not ordered. Crypto prices sliding are not an equity order. No small-cap item against IWM. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
